dimensions.assessment: Directly impacts the United States Merchant Marine Academy athletic programs, cadets, and Department of Transportation administrative personnel.
dimensions.evidence: To support the athletic programs of the United States Merchant Marine Academy.

dimensions.assessment: Provides operational flexibilities such as nonprofit creation, sole-source contracting, and trademark licensing for academy athletics.
dimensions.evidence: the Secretary may establish... a corporation... to support the athletic programs of the United States Merchant Marine Academy.

dimensions.assessment: Authorizes retention and expenditure of licensing fees and transferred nonappropriated funds without new federal appropriations.
dimensions.evidence: may retain and expend fees received from such licensing

dimensions.assessment: Amends title 46 and title 49 to grant new corporate establishment, leasing, and trademark licensing authorities to the Department of Transportation.

dimensions.assessment: Permanent amendments to federal code, though specific leases to the corporation are limited to five years.

importance_detail.rationale: The bill authorizes the Secretary of Transportation to establish a nonprofit corporation and enter into leasing and licensing agreements specifically to support athletic programs at the United States Merchant Marine Academy.
